summary: Visible change: until react-markdown has loaded, a message shows skeleton lines instead of its raw Markdown source; without it (failed, or not there within 3 s) plain text without Markdown syntax. The provider loads it on mount; new preloadMarkdown() in glirastes/react.
howTo: Nothing to do. The placeholder is div[data-component="markdown"][data-state="loading"][aria-busy="true"] with a visually hidden span[data-element="markdown-loading-text"] (locale key markdownLoadingLabel, German ships) and one span[data-element="markdown-placeholder-line"] per estimated line. Its size is inline, so it also takes space with unstyled or in an own layout outside the panel; adjust it with --cm-markdown-placeholder (color), --cm-markdown-placeholder-line-height and --cm-markdown-placeholder-line-gap, or hide it with your own CSS on markdown-placeholder-line. The plain-text fallback is div[data-component="markdown"][data-state="plain"] (code in pre). react-markdown is now downloaded when AiChatProvider mounts, also for a closed floating chat, unless components.Markdown or components.MessageBubble is set; call preloadMarkdown() to start earlier, or await it on the server before renderToString. Streaming server rendering still sends rendered Markdown and hydration keeps it. Tests that read [data-component="markdown"] right after render wait for the renderer (await preloadMarkdown() or waitFor). For mention chips in a chat restored with session.load or createLocalSessionStore before its next turn, set entityDeclarations.
